name: Onboard.io
long_description: Onboard is a SaaS which automates & streamlines the customer onboarding & implementation process. Easily create dynamic launch plans (customized per customer), which are collaborative with clients and visible to all stakeholders.  Onboard is built for onboarding by a team that spent a better part of the last decade onboarding some of the worlds largest brands.
one_liner: Manage & automate customer onboarding and implementation

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Managing member of 57O INVESTMENTS, investing in early stage startups.

Founder of Onboard (YC W22) (https://onboard.io), a B2B SaaS to streamline onboarding for every customer.

Previously founded ZFERRAL INC aka Ambassador (TS NYC 2011) (https://getambassador.com), scaled to about 50 people before selling in 2018.

I also enjoy angel investing, stock trading & sports.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
I’m Will 👋 My focus is simple: identify bottlenecks, design better workflows, and support them with AI systems to help teams move faster and operate more efficiently.

Over my career, I’ve led companies involved in $660M+ in acquisitions across SaaS, prop tech, marketing automation, and health tech.

I love solving operational problems and connecting people. If I can help, reach out — if not, I probably know someone who can.
